input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law and Section 28.2 gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, which is exactly our preferred position. No arbitration provision appears anywhere in the document, so there is no foreign seat concern. The pre-suit executive escalation in Section 28.3 is mutual and expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings, so it does not impair access to the agreed courts. The carve-out permitting temporary injunctive relief in another court is mutual and benefits both parties equally.
